text: DiT-XL/2 full (dit, 256 px, 256 latent tokens, global batch 512) on 2 x 8 H100-SXM-80GB over IB. Single changes (speed-up = t_before / t_after): micro_batch 32->16 x0.86 (M2DX05->M2DX40); grad_sync_every_micro off->on x0.92 (M2DX40->M2DX42). Fastest measured: M2DX30 0.1002 s/update (x3.04 vs M2DX00), 29.57 GiB peak.

DiT-XL/2 full (dit, 256 px, 256 latent tokens, global batch 512) on 2 x 8 H100-SXM-80GB over TCP. Single changes (speed-up = t_before / t_after): grad_sync_every_micro on->off x1.92 (M2DX42T->M2DX40T); micro_batch 32->16 x0.97 (M2DX05T->M2DX40T). Fastest measured: M2DX05T 2.002 s/update, 28.81 GiB peak.

flux1-dev full (diffusers, 1024 px, 4096 latent tokens, global batch 16) on 2 x 8 H100-SXM-80GB over IB. Single changes (speed-up = t_before / t_after): zero_stage 3->2 x1.28 (M2FF00->M2FF01). Fastest measured: M2FF01 1.211 s/update (x1.28 vs M2FF00), 62.35 GiB peak.
DiT-XL/2 full (dit, 256 px, 256 latent tokens, global batch 1024) on 4 x 8 H100-SXM-80GB over IB. Fastest measured: M4DX30 0.103 s/update, 27.37 GiB peak.

flux1-dev full (diffusers, 1024 px, 4096 latent tokens, global batch 32) on 4 x 8 H100-SXM-80GB over IB. Single changes (speed-up = t_before / t_after): zero_stage 3->2 x1.30 (M4FF00->M4FF01). Fastest measured: M4FF01 1.283 s/update (x1.30 vs M4FF00), 57.79 GiB peak.
DiT-XL/2 full (dit, 256 px, 256 latent tokens, global batch 2048) on 8 x 8 H100-SXM-80GB over IB. Fastest measured: M8DX30 0.1051 s/update, 27.65 GiB peak.

DiT-XL/2 (675M, DDP) on 2 x 8 H100 over the InfiniBand fabric measured here (8 x 400 Gb/s per node, GPUDirect RDMA): DDP all-reduces 2.70 GB of fp32 gradients per update (4 B x 674.8M parameters; a ring all-reduce moves about twice that per GPU), and the 2-node step stays close to one node at the same per-GPU batch (one node / two nodes): bf16 + latents x0.987, fp32 reference x0.985, full stack x0.97, 4 nodes x0.94, 8 nodes x0.93. Strong scaling at a global batch of 256 (16 per GPU on 2 nodes): 0.07459 s vs 0.09724 s on one node (x1.30 with twice the GPUs). Holds for this IB fabric; over TCP see ib-tcp-dit.

DiT-XL/2 on 2 x 8 H100 over IB with 2-step gradient accumulation (global batch 512): no_sync until the boundary gives x1.09 over an all-reduce on every micro-batch (one node: x1.06); 32 x 1 beats 16 x 2 by x1.17. Holds for this IB fabric.

The same 2 x 8 H100 nodes with NCCL over TCP sockets (NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1) instead of IB: DiT-XL/2 bf16 + latents runs 2.002 s vs 0.1478 s over IB (x13.54): the 2.70 GB fp32 gradient all-reduce per update sets the step. With 2-step accumulation, no_sync gives x1.92 over TCP (IB: x1.09); 32 x 1 vs 16 x 2 x1.03 (IB: x1.17). Holds for this TCP link only.

2 x 8 H100 over IB at the same per-GPU batch as one node (step time one node / two nodes; 1.0 = perfect weak scaling): SD1.5 x0.995; SDXL x0.983; FLUX.1 LoRA x0.986; Wan2.1-1.3B x0.984; Qwen-Image LoRA (DiffSynth) x1.001; FLUX.1 full ZeRO-3 x1.004; FLUX.1 full ZeRO-2 x0.96; measured on this IB fabric.

4 x 8 H100 over IB at the same per-GPU batch as one node (step time one node / four nodes): SD1.5 x0.987; SDXL x0.97; FLUX.1 LoRA x0.984; Wan2.1-1.3B x0.94; FLUX.1 full ZeRO-3 x0.93; FLUX.1 full ZeRO-2 x0.91; DiT-XL/2 bf16 + latents x0.97; over TCP (NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1) DiT-XL/2 x0.05; measured on this IB fabric.

8 x 8 H100 over IB at the same per-GPU batch as one node (step time one node / eight nodes): DiT-XL/2 full stack x0.93; DiT-XL/2 bf16 + latents x0.95; over TCP x0.04; Wan2.1-1.3B x0.94; FLUX.1 full ZeRO-3 x0.86; measured on this IB fabric.

FLUX.1-dev full fine-tune under DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 moves about 71 GB per GPU per update (bf16 parameter all-gather in forward and backward + gradient reduce-scatter, 3 x 2 B x 11.9B): one node 1.553 s, 2 nodes over IB 1.548 s, over TCP 29.35 s; ZeRO-2 on 2 nodes 1.211 s.
